ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: With the rapid development of information technology, online shopping has already become widespread in people's lives. In a certain logistics company, goods often use the device shown in the figure: a uniform wooden board is placed on two completely identical parallel long cylinders whose axes are in the same horizontal plane, and the center of gravity of the wooden board is equidistant from the two cylinders. The radius of each cylinder is r=2cm, the mass of the wooden board is m=5kg, and the coefficient of kinetic friction between the wooden board and the cylinders is μ=0.2. The two cylinders rotate in opposite directions about their axes with angular velocity ω. Now a pulling force F passing through the center of gravity of the wooden board and parallel to the cylinder axes is applied to the wooden board, causing it to move at a constant speed v=0.6m/s along the cylinder surfaces. Take g=10m/s. Which of the following statements is correct ( )
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: If ω=40rad/s, then the horizontal pulling force F=6N

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, a uniform wooden board is placed horizontally on two mutually parallel long cylinders; the axes of the two cylinders are parallel and in the same horizontal plane; a pulling force F along the direction of the cylinder axes is drawn on the wooden board. The rotation directions of angular velocity ω are marked beside the two cylinders, and the left and right cylinders rotate in opposite directions. The problem statement explains that the center of gravity of the wooden board is equidistant from the two cylinders. Then reason: By symmetry, the supporting forces at the two contact points are equal, N1=N2=mg/2=5×10/2=25 N. The magnitude of the kinetic friction force at each point is f=μN=0.2×25=5 N. The surface linear velocity of the cylinder is u=ωr=40×0.02=0.8 m/s. The wooden board moves at a constant speed along the direction of the cylinder axes, with speed v=0.6 m/s; at each contact point, the sliding velocity of the wooden board relative to the cylinder is synthesized from the axial component 0.6 m/s and the cylinder surface component perpendicular to the axial direction 0.8 m/s, with magnitude sqrt(0.6^2+0.8^2)=1.0 m/s. The direction of the friction force is opposite to the direction of relative sliding, so the magnitude of the component of the friction force at each point in the direction of motion of the wooden board is 5×0.6/1.0=3 N, and its direction obstructs the motion of the wooden board. Since the two cylinders rotate in opposite directions, the friction components perpendicular to the direction of motion cancel each other out, while the two resistance components along the direction of motion add together. When the wooden board moves at constant speed, the external pulling force balances the total axial friction resistance, so F=2×3=6 N.
